lead: Stage 1, year 1. The key goal is the IAC.

groups.note: Usually within 3–6 months. You need it to move from CT1 to CT2. It covers EPA 1 (pre-operative assessment) and EPA 2 (general anaesthesia for ASA 1–2 patients having uncomplicated surgery).

lead: Stage 1, year 2. The key goal is the IACOA.

groups.h: Initial Assessment of Competence in Obstetric Anaesthesia (IACOA)
groups.note: At least 3 months, usually starting after a year of anaesthesia, and it must be done by the end of 2 years of anaesthetic training. It covers EPA 3 (labour analgesia) and EPA 4 (anaesthesia for ASA 1–2 obstetric surgery, including category 1–3 caesarean section).

By at least 3 faculty members, with 2 obstetric trainers as signatories.
